name: masjid-display-shell
description: Android shell for the react_vite Mosque TV Display. Bundles the built web app into an APK that runs offline on Android TV boxes and phones.

scripts.build:web: cd ../react_vite && cross-env VITE_NATIVE=1 npm run build
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease
